widgets_values:
# H3 Regenerate · native Swift/MLX

Prepare native H3 restoration models in Studio or use `WeeToddCLI models prepare-h3`. Connect its ordinary original Ref2VA profile, shared model library and Swift CLI.

Choose a 24 FPS SDR source. H3 preserves source timing and original audio; other rates reject before inference. Three publisher refinement steps and the required Refiner/Turbo/Sharp stack are fixed. Direct learned upscaling supports at most 2× per axis. Select Released H3 or Fast H3 decoder explicitly. Unqualified geometry stops before execution.

This is a portable template; fill local paths before queueing. No Python model runtime or converter is required. See studio/H3_REGENERATE_SETTINGS.md for qualification and resource limits.

Official model source: https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-Model/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K

Queue the workflow only after connecting local paths. ComfyUI/models/ may link to the shared model library; keep weights out of project checkouts.
